chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

A Muslim man does not gain a benefit after Islam better than a Muslim wife who pleases him when he looks at her, obeys him when he commands her, and safeguards herself and his wealth when he is absent from her.

key_terms.الْإِسْلَامِ: Islam, the faith after which this blessing is described
key_terms.تَحْفَظُهُ: she safeguards him, meaning his rights, herself, and his property
key_terms.تَسُرُّهُ: she pleases him and brings him joy
key_terms.زَوْجَةٍ مُسْلِمَةٍ: a Muslim wife characterized by faith and righteousness

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the best benefit a Muslim man gains after Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the great blessing of a righteous Muslim spouse in a believer’s life. It highlights marital harmony, obedience within the household, and trustworthiness in protecting personal chastity and property.
